0022600203.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) host the Los Angeles Lakers (9-2, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) in the Hawks' 12th game of the season. Atlanta enters on a four-game winning streak and a 6-4 record over its last ten, while Los Angeles is on a five-game winning streak and is 8-2 over its last ten. Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while the Lakers have Luka Doncic (back soreness) and Quentin Grimes (finger) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the last meeting was on January 13, 2026, in Los Angeles, where the Hawks lost 141-116.
